meta.title: DEE Parameter Knowledge from Upstream Projects
meta.description: Structured extraction of DEE parameter definitions from deew and DeeZy projects

encode_to_atmos_ddp.description: Encodes Dolby Atmos content in Dolby Digital Plus bitstreams

parameters.name: data_rate
parameters.notes: Mode-specific bitrate set. Hard max 1664 kbps.

parameters.name: metering_mode
parameters.notes: Loudness metering mode. 1770-4 is recommended for Atmos.

parameters.name: dialogue_intelligence
parameters.notes: Dialogue Intelligence enabled. Ignored for 1770-1 or LeqA metering mode.

parameters.name: speech_threshold
parameters.notes: Speech gating threshold percent.

parameters.name: timecode_frame_rate
parameters.notes: Frame rate associated with specified timecode.

parameters.name: start
parameters.notes: Encoding start point. Can be 'first_frame_of_action' or timestamp.

parameters.name: end
parameters.notes: Encoding end point. Can be 'end_of_file' or timestamp.

parameters.name: time_base
parameters.notes: Time reference for encoding.

parameters.name: prepend_silence_duration
parameters.notes: Silence duration in seconds to prepend.

parameters.name: append_silence_duration
parameters.notes: Silence duration in seconds to append.

parameters.name: line_mode_drc_profile
parameters.notes: DRC profile for line mode. Music profile locks to 'music_light' unless --allow-fixed-override.

parameters.name: rf_mode_drc_profile
parameters.notes: DRC profile for RF mode. Music profile locks to 'music_light' unless --allow-fixed-override.

parameters.name: loro_center_mix_level
parameters.notes: LoRo center mix level for downmixing.

parameters.name: loro_surround_mix_level
parameters.notes: LoRo surround mix level for downmixing.

parameters.name: ltrt_center_mix_level
parameters.notes: LtRt center mix level for downmixing.

parameters.name: ltrt_surround_mix_level
parameters.notes: LtRt surround mix level for downmixing.

parameters.name: preferred_downmix_mode
parameters.notes: Preferred stereo downmix method.

parameters.name: surround_trim_5_1
parameters.notes: Custom surround trim for 5.1 on the Atmos path. Present in the real DEE XSD for encode_to_atmos_ddp.

parameters.name: height_trim_5_1
parameters.notes: Custom height trim for 5.1 on the Atmos path. Present in the real DEE XSD for encode_to_atmos_ddp.

parameters.name: custom_dialnorm
parameters.notes: Custom dialogue normalization. 0 = auto (recommended). Dangerous to set manually.

parameters.name: encoding_backend
parameters.notes: Hidden parameter for Atmos BluRay 7.1 mode. Not present in the exported XSD, but runtime-verified on DEE 5.2.1. Omitting it or setting it to PE produces the same output after DEE falls back to atmosprocessor.

parameters.name: encoder_mode
parameters.notes: Hidden parameter for Atmos BluRay 7.1 mode. Runtime-verified on DEE 5.2.1 and behaviorally required for the 1664 kbps Atmos BluRay bitrate set.

profile_music_fixed_values.notes: Music profile locks specific DRC and loudness settings for consistency.

streaming_mode_forbids_extensions.reason: Streaming mode is for web/OTT; extensions are BluRay only.

bluray_mode_requires_extensions.notes: BluRay 7.1 Atmos requires encoder extensions. Automatically injected by resolver.

special_behaviors.title: 7.1 Channel Swap
special_behaviors.description: DEE internally swaps Ls/Rs with Lrs/Rrs for 7.1 sources. ffmpeg pre-processing compensates.

special_behaviors.title: Bitrate Hard Maximum
special_behaviors.description: All Atmos DDP bitrates cannot exceed 1664 kbps (Blu-ray spec limit).

special_behaviors.title: Atmos Mode Bitrate Separation
special_behaviors.description: Streaming Atmos uses 5.1 bitrate set; BluRay uses 7.1 bitrate set.

special_behaviors.title: Custom Dialnorm Danger
special_behaviors.description: Manual dialnorm setting is dangerous and requires explicit warning to user.
special_behaviors.notes: 0 means auto-measurement. Only set non-zero with expert guidance.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Bluray Backend Normalization
runtime_observations.result: All three variants succeed and produce identical EC3 output. When encoding_backend is omitted or set to PE, DEE warns that PE backend is unsupported for Blu-ray mode and falls back to atmosprocessor.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Bluray Encoder Mode Gates Bitrate
runtime_observations.result: encoder_mode=bluray is behaviorally required for the 1664 kbps Blu-ray bitrate set. Removing encoder_mode causes DEE to reject the job with 'Invalid data_rate value: 1664'.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Streaming And Bluray Bitrate Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: All streaming bitrates in the local schema succeed at runtime. For Atmos Blu-ray mode, DEE 5.2.1 rejects 768 and 1024 with 'DD+JOC: min data rate is 1152 for Blu-ray mode' and accepts 1152 through 1664.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos DDP71 Generated Mode Is Rejected By DEE
runtime_observations.result: The generated ddp71 Atmos path does not execute successfully on DEE 5.2.1. DEE rejects the job during filter validation with 'Invalid encoder_mode value: ddp71'.

runtime_observations.title: Unknown Atmos Trim Fields Are Ignored For Streaming And Bluray
runtime_observations.result: Streaming and bluray generated XML both encode successfully and produce byte-identical EC3 outputs after replacing surround_trim_5_1 with surround_trim_9_1. This indicates unknown trim fields on the Atmos path are tolerated and ignored for these modes on this sample.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Preferred Downmix Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: Atmos streaming accepts all tested preferred_downmix_mode values. Atmos bluray rejects ltrt-pl2 with a mode-specific runtime error while accepting loro, ltrt, and not_indicated.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Path Rejects PCM Metadata Knobs
runtime_observations.result: encode_to_atmos_ddp rejects pcm_to_ddp-specific metadata knobs as unknown downmix properties across both streaming and bluray. Atmos XML should not expose dolby_surround_mode or dolby_surround_ex_mode.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Loudness Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: Representative Atmos loudness controls are runtime-verified on both streaming and bluray. DEE 5.2.1 accepts metering_mode variants 1770-4/1770-3/LeqA, dialogue_intelligence toggles, and boundary speech_threshold values 0 and 100 on the tested ADM sample.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Timecode Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: Representative Atmos timecode controls are runtime-verified on both streaming and bluray. DEE 5.2.1 accepts the tested timecode_frame_rate variants and also accepts switching time_base to the opposite mode default on the tested ADM sample.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Silence Duration Format Gap
runtime_observations.result: The Atmos path accepts numeric second values for silence duration, but DEE 5.2.1 rejects timestamp-like silence duration strings on streaming with a 'value is not a number' error. The local schema intentionally remains conservative here.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Representative Misc Runtime Smoke
runtime_observations.sample: testfiles/testADM.wav on streaming and bluray profiles
rejected: bluray + start=00:00:00:00 when embedded start is 3600s
runtime_observations.result: Low-value Atmos controls now have representative runtime smoke coverage. The tested start/end, silence, DRC, and custom_dialnorm overrides succeed on their intended paths, while bluray start values before the embedded file start remain a known conservative gap.

runtime_observations.title: Atmos Trim Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: Representative Atmos trim controls are runtime-verified on both streaming and bluray. DEE 5.2.1 accepts tested valid trim values and rejects bogus trim values for the exposed surround_trim_5_1 and height_trim_5_1 properties.

pcm_to_ddp.description: Encodes PCM input to Dolby Digital Plus bitstreams

parameters.name: metering_mode
parameters.notes: PCM loudness metering mode. Runtime-verified on DEE 5.2.1: pcm_to_ddp rejects 1770-4 across dd, ddp, ddp71, and bluray.
parameters.source: deew xml_base comments, DeeZy payload defaults, 2026-03-10 local runtime experiment

parameters.name: data_rate
parameters.notes: Runtime-verified PCM bitrate sets on DEE 5.2.1. dd/ddp use the 5.1 path; ddp71/bluray are verified for both 6ch and 8ch inputs. Local defaults intentionally use the highest runtime-verified bitrate per mode.

parameters.name: encoder_mode
parameters.notes: Required selector for the pcm_to_ddp path. Resolver injects the mode-matching encoder selector.

parameters.name: bitstream_mode
parameters.notes: Previously fixed in generated XML; now exposed as official schema.

parameters.name: downmix_config
parameters.notes: Mode-dependent PCM output topology selector.
parameters.source: deew xml_base comments, DeeZy json flows, 2026-03-10 schema expansion

parameters.name: advanced_pcm_flags
parameters.notes: Previously fixed-only PCM knobs promoted into the formal schema during parity work. starting_timecode overrides are runtime-verified only for dd and bluray; frame_rate overrides work independently on ddp.
parameters.source: deew xml_base comments, DeeZy payloads, 2026-03-10 schema expansion

profile_music_fixed_values.notes: Music profile locks specific DRC and loudness settings for consistency.

atmos_only_overrides_are_unsupported.notes: These knobs are not accepted on the pcm_to_ddp path in local runtime tests.

dd_mode_requires_downmix_config.notes: pcm_to_ddp dd currently models the 5.1 AC-3 path only.

ddp_mode_requires_downmix_config.notes: pcm_to_ddp ddp currently models the 5.1 E-AC-3 path only.

bluray_mode_requires_downmix_config.notes: pcm_to_ddp bluray remains on the 7.1/off path.

ddp71_mode_requires_downmix_config.notes: pcm_to_ddp ddp71 remains on the 7.1/off path.

starting_timecode_requires_dd_or_bluray.notes: Starting embedded timecodes are accepted on dd and bluray. ddp rejects starting_timecode=auto with an embedded timecode support error.

metering_mode_1770_4_is_invalid_on_pcm.notes: pcm_to_ddp rejects 1770-4 on DEE 5.2.1 across dd, ddp, ddp71, and bluray. The local schema intentionally excludes it.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Loudness Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: Representative PCM loudness controls are runtime-verified across dd, ddp, ddp71, and bluray. DEE 5.2.1 accepts dialogue_intelligence toggles and boundary speech_threshold values 0 and 100 on the tested 6ch PCM sample.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Timecode Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: Representative PCM timecode controls are runtime-verified across dd, ddp, ddp71, and bluray. DEE 5.2.1 accepts the tested timecode_frame_rate variants and both time_base values on the tested 6ch PCM sample.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Metering Mode Compatibility
runtime_observations.result: pcm_to_ddp accepts 1770-3 but rejects 1770-4 before workflow execution with 'Invalid metering_mode value: 1770-4.' across all four modeled modes.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Bitrate Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.sample: testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg -ac 6 -> 6ch.wav and ffmpeg pan workaround -> 8ch.wav
runtime_observations.result: Both 6ch and 8ch inputs accept the full documented dd/ddp bitrate sets on the pcm_to_ddp path. dd still requires AC-3 output, while ddp uses EC-3 output.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP 6ch Input Expands To 7.1 Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: 6ch PCM input is encoded in 7.1 mode on ddp71 and bluray, and the same 5.1 bitrate windows remain valid for dd/ddp with downmix_config=5.1.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP DD Output Must Use AC-3 Node
runtime_observations.result: The dd mode succeeds with output.ac3 and fails workflow construction with output.ec3 because the filter produces audio.ac3, not audio.ec3.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Downmix Config Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.sample: testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg -ac 6 -> 6ch.wav; testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg pan workaround -> 8ch.wav
runtime_observations.result: Runtime behavior is input-sensitive: dd/ddp accept downmix_config=off for 6ch input, but 8ch + off fails because the resulting output channels are 8 and DD/DDP only allow 1/2/6. ddp71 and bluray consistently require downmix_config=off.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Silence Duration Format Gap
runtime_observations.result: pcm_to_ddp accepts numeric second values for silence duration, but frame-count syntax depends on an indicated frame rate. With timecode_frame_rate=not_indicated, DEE 5.2.1 rejects 0f-based prepend/append_silence_duration values.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Representative Misc Runtime Smoke
runtime_observations.sample: testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg -ac 6 -> 6ch.wav on dd and bluray
runtime_observations.result: The remaining low-value PCM controls now have representative runtime smoke coverage on dd and bluray. These results are sufficient to classify the area as known conservative gaps rather than unknown behavior, while leaving finer mode-by-mode tuning outside the current scope.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Starting Timecode Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.sample: testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg -ac 6 -> 6ch.wav with explicit embedded timecode inputs
runtime_observations.result: Starting embedded timecodes are accepted only on dd and bluray. ddp and ddp71 both fail with the embedded timecode support error.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Frame Rate Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: DEE 5.2.1 accepts arbitrary frame_rate strings across all tested pcm_to_ddp modes. The local schema intentionally models frame_rate as free-form string even though the official contract is narrower.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Bitstream Mode Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: commentary is runtime-verified across dd, ddp, ddp71, and bluray. Invalid bitstream_mode values are rejected at workflow construction.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Preferred Downmix PL2 Compatibility
runtime_observations.result: preferred_downmix_mode=ltrt-pl2 is runtime-verified on ddp and ddp71, but rejected on dd and bluray with explicit mode-specific errors. The other tested preferred_downmix_mode values are accepted across all modeled pcm_to_ddp modes.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Boolean Processing Knob Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.result: The newly exposed boolean processing knobs have dedicated runtime coverage across all four pcm_to_ddp modes. Valid alternate values succeed and bogus values fail with parameter-specific validation errors.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Metadata Knob Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.sample: testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg -ac 6 -> 6ch.wav; testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg pan workaround -> 8ch.wav
runtime_observations.result: The exposed metadata knobs are runtime-verified across all four pcm_to_ddp modes on both 6ch and 8ch inputs. Bluray normalizes dolby_surround_ex_mode=no/not_indicated to yes. Invalid dolby_surround_* values fail cleanly, while invalid user_data fails with an internal stoi parsing error.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Allow Hybrid Downmix Runtime Matrix
runtime_observations.sample: testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg -ac 6 -> 6ch.wav; testfiles/16ch.wav -> ffmpeg pan workaround -> 8ch.wav
runtime_observations.result: allow_hybrid_downmix=true is runtime-verified across all modeled pcm_to_ddp modes for both 6ch and 8ch input. Invalid values are rejected with a parameter-specific validation error.

runtime_observations.title: PCM to DDP Bluray Accepts Only encoder_mode Extension
runtime_observations.result: Baseline 8ch PCM -> pcm_to_ddp -> bluray encoding succeeds. Injecting any of the rejected properties causes DEE to fail before workflow execution with 'Unknown property'.

parameters.name: dialogue_intelligence
parameters.notes: Official dialogue intelligence toggle.

parameters.name: speech_threshold
parameters.notes: Official speech gating threshold percent.

parameters.name: timecode_frame_rate
parameters.notes: Frame rate associated with start/end timecode fields.

parameters.name: start
parameters.notes: Official start point field; local schema accepts only documented timecode forms.

parameters.name: end
parameters.notes: Official end point field; local schema accepts only documented timecode forms.

parameters.name: time_base

parameters.name: prepend_silence_duration

parameters.name: append_silence_duration
parameters.notes: Local thd_v1 keeps the official decimal-seconds interpretation and does not expose frame syntax in v1.

parameters.name: custom_dialnorm

parameters.name: presentation_8ch_drc_profile

parameters.name: presentation_6ch_drc_profile

parameters.name: presentation_2ch_drc_profile
parameters.notes: Maps to presentation_2ch/drc_profile.

runtime_observations.title: TrueHD MLP Runtime Smoke
runtime_observations.result: DEE 5.2.1 accepts the minimal thd_v1 atmos_mezz -> encode_to_dthd -> mlp path and produces a non-empty MLP output.

runtime_observations.title: TrueHD Representative Parameter Runtime Smoke
runtime_observations.result: Representative thd_v1 exposed parameters are runtime-verified on DEE 5.2.1 for the tested Atmos mezzanine sample.

runtime_observations.title: TrueHD MP4 Feasibility
runtime_observations.result: DEE 5.2.1 rejects output/mp4 on the encode_to_dthd path during workflow construction because encode_to_dthd produces audio.mlp while output/mp4 does not consume audio.mlp. thd_v1 keeps mp4 out of the public interface.

notes.xsd_vs_hidden: XSD exposes 'official' parameters; community-discovered parameters must be separated into runtime-verified extensions versus folklore. As of the 2026-03-09 experiments, encoding_backend and encoder_mode are runtime-verified on the Atmos Bluray path, while surround_trim_* is not accepted on pcm_to_ddp.
notes.auto_injection: Some parameters are automatically set by the resolver based on mode/profile. These should not appear in user input but are in generated XML.
notes.music_profile: Music profile enforces specific DRC and loudness settings. This is a safety feature for music encoding workflows.
notes.future_templates: The repository now models atmos_ec3_v1 and pcm_ddp_v1. Additional templates (THD, AC4) still need separate parameter matrices.
